title: rosa mollis var. pseudorubiginosa
intro: Rosa mollis var. pseudorubiginosa, commonly known as the fragrant wild rose, is a species of flowering plant in the rose family. It is used for its medicinal and therapeutic properties, which include relieving stress and anxiety, promoting sleep, and reducing inflammation due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its calming and sedative effects, which are said to be due to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils. However, more research is needed to confirm the full extent of its therapeutic actions and the specific bioactive constituents responsible for its health benefits.
